neowiki-bundle-file-not-json: Error shown, under {{msg-mw|neowiki-schemas-import-error}} or in the install view, when the chosen file is not JSON.
neowiki-bundle-file-empty: Error shown when the chosen file holds nothing to import.
neowiki-bundle-file-section-not-object:
Error shown when a top-level entry of the chosen file is not a JSON object. Parameters:
* $1 - the entry: "schemas", "layouts", "mappings" or "subjects", which are JSON keys and not translated
neowiki-bundle-file-invalid-metadata: Error shown when the model bundle metadata of the chosen file is not valid. "bundle", "name", "version" and "description" are JSON keys and must not be translated.
neowiki-bundle-file-duplicate:
Error shown when two entries of the chosen file name the same page, such as "Person" and "person". Parameters:
* $1 - the name
neowiki-bundle-file-schema-no-property-d:
Error shown when an entry under "schemas" of the chosen file is not a schema. "propertyDefinitions" is a JSON key and must not be translated. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the entry
neowiki-bundle-file-invalid-schema:
Error shown when a schema in the chosen file cannot be read. Parameters:
* $1 - the schema name
* $2 - the reason, untranslated
neowiki-bundle-file-invalid-layout:
Error shown when an entry under "layouts" of the chosen file is not a layout. Parameters:
* $1 - the layout name
* $2 - the reason: {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-file-layout-fields}}, or an untranslated error
neowiki-bundle-file-layout-fields: The reason given in {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-file-invalid-layout}} when a layout lacks one of the fields every layout needs. "schema" and "type" are JSON keys and must not be translated.
neowiki-bundle-file-invalid-mapping:
Error shown when an entry under "mappings" of the chosen file is not a JSON object. Parameters:
* $1 - the mapping name
neowiki-bundle-file-invalid-subject:
Error shown when an entry under "subjects" of the chosen file is not a subject. "subjects", "schema" and "statements" are JSON keys and must not be translated. Parameters:
* $1 - the key of the entry
neowiki-special-datamodel: Name of [[Special:DataModel]], the page that lists the installed model bundles and the schemas, layouts and mappings of this wiki, and from which model bundles are installed, updated and exported. "Data model" is a NeoWiki term.
neowiki-overview-datamodel-description: Description of the [[Special:DataModel]] link on [[Special:NeoWiki]], shown to every reader, including those who cannot install model bundles.
neowiki-bundle-install-title: Label of the button on [[Special:DataModel]] that starts installing a model bundle, and heading of the view that installs one.
neowiki-bundle-update-title:
Heading of the view on [[Special:DataModel]], and title of the import dialog on [[Special:Schemas]], that updates an installed model bundle. The name follows "model bundle", as model bundle names often end in "model". Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the model bundle
neowiki-bundle-export-title: Label of the button on [[Special:DataModel]] that opens the export view, and heading of that view.
neowiki-bundle-source-file: Label of the field for choosing a model bundle file on the computer, in the install view of [[Special:DataModel]].
neowiki-bundle-source-file-button: Label of the button that opens the file chooser, under {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-source-file}}.
neowiki-bundle-source-url: Label of the field for the URL of a model bundle file, in the install view of [[Special:DataModel]].
neowiki-bundle-source-url-button: Label of the button that loads the model bundle file from the URL entered under {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-source-url}}.
neowiki-bundle-source-catalog: Label of the list of the model bundles that the wiki's catalogs offer, in the install view of [[Special:DataModel]].
neowiki-bundle-catalog-models: Heading of the model bundles a catalog lists as models, which describe what the wiki holds, in the install view of [[Special:DataModel]].
neowiki-bundle-catalog-destinations: Heading of the model bundles a catalog lists as destinations, which make the wiki's data usable elsewhere, such as in Europeana, in the install view of [[Special:DataModel]].
neowiki-bundle-catalog-installed: Shown beside a model bundle of a catalog that this wiki has installed, when the installed version has no version number.
neowiki-bundle-catalog-installed-version:
Shown beside a model bundle of a catalog that this wiki has installed. Parameters:
* $1 - the installed version
neowiki-bundle-catalog-load:
Accessible name of the button that loads a model bundle of a catalog, whose visible label is {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-source-url-button}}. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the model bundle
neowiki-bundle-catalog-unreadable:
Shown in the install view of [[Special:DataModel]] for a catalog that could not be read, such as one whose server does not let other websites read it. Parameters:
* $1 - the URL of the catalog
neowiki-bundle-catalog-empty: Shown in the install view of [[Special:DataModel]] when the wiki's catalogs list no model bundle.
neowiki-bundle-catalog-missing-requireme:
Error shown when a model bundle of a catalog requires another that no catalog of the wiki lists. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the model bundle
* $2 - the name of the model bundle it requires
neowiki-bundle-catalog-wrong-file:
Error shown when the file a catalog gives for a model bundle holds another one. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the model bundle the catalog lists
* $2 - the URL of the file
neowiki-bundle-url-not-web: Error shown when the address to read a model bundle file from is not an http or https URL.
neowiki-bundle-url-unreachable: Error shown when a model bundle file cannot be read from a URL, because the network failed or because the server does not let other websites read the file (CORS).
neowiki-bundle-url-failed:
Error shown when the server at a model bundle URL refuses the request. Parameters:
* $1 - the HTTP status code, such as 404
neowiki-bundle-other-bundle:
Error shown when the file chosen to update a model bundle holds another model bundle. The name follows "model bundle", as model bundle names often end in "model". Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the model bundle in the file
* $2 - the name of the model bundle being updated
neowiki-bundle-name: Label of the field for the name of a model bundle, in the install view of [[Special:DataModel]] for a file that names none, and in its export view.
neowiki-bundle-name-help: Help text under {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-name}} in the install view.
neowiki-bundle-name-unusable: Error shown when a model bundle name cannot be used, as it cannot title the bundle's install record page. What it lists is what a page title cannot hold, and the slash.
neowiki-bundle-version:
The version of a model bundle, shown after its name and under the title of the import dialog on [[Special:Schemas]]. Parameters:
* $1 - the version, as its authors write it
neowiki-bundle-updates:
Shown above the preview when the chosen file holds a model bundle this wiki has already, which installing it updates. Parameters:
* $1 - the installed version
neowiki-bundle-updates-unversioned: Shown instead of {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-updates}} when the model bundle this wiki has was installed without a version.
neowiki-bundle-comparing: Shown while the file is compared with what this wiki has.
neowiki-bundle-progress:
Progress shown while an import or a model bundle install writes. Parameters:
* $1 - how many writes are done
* $2 - how many there are
neowiki-bundle-install-button: Label of the button that installs a model bundle as the preview shows.
neowiki-bundle-update-button: Label of the button that updates an installed model bundle as the preview shows.
neowiki-bundle-back: Label of the button that returns from the results of an install or update to [[Special:DataModel]]. "Data model" is a NeoWiki term.
neowiki-bundle-type-schema: Heading of the schemas in a preview, an export and a model bundle on [[Special:DataModel]].
neowiki-bundle-type-layout: Heading of the layouts in a preview and a model bundle on [[Special:DataModel]].
neowiki-bundle-type-mapping: Heading of the ontology mappings in a preview, an export and a model bundle on [[Special:DataModel]].
neowiki-bundle-type-subject: Heading of the subjects in a preview and a model bundle on [[Special:DataModel]].
neowiki-bundle-preview-all:
Label of the checkbox that checks every schema, layout or mapping listed under it. Parameters:
* $1 - how many are listed
neowiki-bundle-preview-schema-group:
Label of the checkbox that checks every subject of one schema in an import preview. Parameters:
* $1 - the schema name
* $2 - how many of its subjects the file holds
neowiki-bundle-preview-quiet:
Summary of the folded list of the items of a group that this wiki has as the file has them, which an import leaves as they are. Parameters:
* $1 - how many
neowiki-bundle-preview-show-changes: Label of the button that shows how the version in the file differs from the version on this wiki.
neowiki-bundle-preview-hide-changes: Label of the button that hides what {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-preview-show-changes}} showed.
neowiki-bundle-diff-here: Legend of the removed lines when comparing two versions: they are the version on this wiki.
neowiki-bundle-diff-upstream: Legend of the added lines when comparing two versions: they are the version in the file.
neowiki-bundle-status-new: Status of what the file holds and this wiki does not.
neowiki-bundle-status-declined: Status of an item of the model bundle that this wiki does not have because an earlier install or update left it unticked. Ticked, it is installed.
neowiki-bundle-status-unchanged: Status of what this wiki has as the file or the installed model bundle has it.
neowiki-bundle-status-differs: Status of what this wiki has with other content than the file, where no install record says where that version came from.
neowiki-bundle-status-changed-upstream: Status of what the new version of a model bundle changed and this wiki did not.
neowiki-bundle-status-changed-both: Status of what both the new version of a model bundle and this wiki changed.
neowiki-bundle-status-changed-here: Status of what this wiki changed since the model bundle installed it.
neowiki-bundle-status-deleted-here: Status of what this wiki deleted after a model bundle installed it.
neowiki-bundle-status-deleted-here-chang: Status of what this wiki deleted and the new version of the model bundle changed.
neowiki-bundle-status-removed-upstream: Status of what the installed version of a model bundle has and the new version does not.
neowiki-bundle-status-conflict:
Status of what cannot be installed. Parameters:
* $1 - why, such as {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-conflict-owned}}
neowiki-bundle-status-unreadable: Status of an item of a model bundle that could not be read from this wiki.
neowiki-bundle-page-title-taken:
Shown under the status of a subject to create whose page title is taken on this wiki. Parameters:
* $1 - the title the page gets instead: the subject ID
neowiki-bundle-conflict-unreadable:
Reason something cannot be imported. Parameters:
* $1 - the error, as the wiki reported it
neowiki-bundle-conflict-owned:
Reason something cannot be installed: another installed model bundle has it. The name follows "model bundle", as model bundle names often end in "model". Parameters:
* $1 - the name of that model bundle
neowiki-bundle-conflict-dependence: Reason a schema cannot be imported: it would change whether its subjects are dependent subjects, which no save may change.
neowiki-bundle-conflict-subject-schema:
Reason a subject cannot be imported: a subject of another schema has its ID, and a subject cannot change schema. Parameters:
* $1 - the schema of the subject on this wiki
neowiki-bundle-conflict-id-in-use:
Reason a subject cannot be imported: the ID of the subject, or of one of its dependent subjects, belongs to another subject. Parameters:
* $1 - the subject ID
neowiki-bundle-conflict-dependent-schema:
Reason a subject cannot be imported: its dependent subjects are of a schema that this wiki does not have, or has as a schema of standalone subjects, and that the import does not create. Parameters:
* $1 - the schema name
neowiki-bundle-remove-blocked-used: Status of a schema the new version of a model bundle no longer has, which is not removed, as subjects use it; also the reason its removal failed.
neowiki-bundle-remove-blocked-referenced: Status of a subject the new version of a model bundle no longer has, which is not removed, as other subjects point to it.
neowiki-bundle-remove-blocked-unreadable:
Status of what the new version of a model bundle no longer has, which is not removed, as its version on this wiki could not be read. Parameters:
* $1 - the error, as the wiki reported it
neowiki-bundle-write-violations:
Reason a subject could not be written. Parameters:
* $1 - the validation codes, each with the property it is on, separated by {{msg-mw|comma-separator}}
neowiki-bundle-result-nothing: Shown when an import or install had nothing to write.
neowiki-bundle-result-failed:
Heading of what an import could not write, each with the reason. Parameters:
* $1 - how many
neowiki-bundle-result-created:
Heading of what an import created. Parameters:
* $1 - how many
neowiki-bundle-result-replaced:
Heading of what an import replaced. Parameters:
* $1 - how many
neowiki-bundle-result-removed:
Heading of what an update removed. Parameters:
* $1 - how many
neowiki-subject-noun: The word for a subject, shown beside one in a list with schemas, layouts and mappings.
neowiki-bundle-installed:
Shown above what an install wrote, once the model bundle is recorded as installed. The name follows "model bundle", as model bundle names often end in "model". Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the model bundle
neowiki-bundle-updated:
Shown above what an update wrote, once the model bundle is recorded as installed. The name follows "model bundle", as model bundle names often end in "model". Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the model bundle
* $2 - the version it was updated to
neowiki-bundle-updated-unversioned:
Shown instead of {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-updated}} when the file the model bundle was updated from gives no version. The name follows "model bundle", as model bundle names often end in "model". Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the model bundle
neowiki-bundle-not-written:
Shown under {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-installed}} or {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-updated}} when some of the items could not be written, which are listed below it. Parameters:
* $1 - how many items were not written
neowiki-bundle-record-failed:
Shown after what an install or update wrote, when the install record could not be saved. The name follows "model bundle", as model bundle names often end in "model". Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the model bundle
* $2 - the error, as the wiki reported it
neowiki-bundle-install-summary:
Edit summary of what installing a model bundle writes. The name follows "model bundle", as model bundle names often end in "model". Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the model bundle
neowiki-bundle-update-summary:
Edit summary of what updating a model bundle writes. The name follows "model bundle", as model bundle names often end in "model". Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the model bundle
neowiki-bundle-export-dependent-subjects: Shown beside a schema in the export view whose subjects are dependent subjects, in place of the switch that includes its subjects.
neowiki-bundle-export-subjects: Label of the switch that includes the subjects of a schema in the export, when their number is not known.
neowiki-bundle-export-subjects-count:
Label of the switch that includes the subjects of a schema in the export. Parameters:
* $1 - how many subjects the schema has, formatted
* $2 - the same number, unformatted, for PLURAL
neowiki-bundle-export-no-subjects: Shown instead of the switch that includes the subjects of a schema in the export, when the schema has none.
neowiki-bundle-export-adds-schemas:
Shown beside the switch that includes the subjects of a schema in the export, once switched on, when their dependent subjects are of schemas not chosen, which the export adds. Parameters:
* $1 - the names of those schemas, as a list
* $2 - how many there are, for PLURAL
neowiki-bundle-export-layouts: Label of the checkbox that includes the layouts of the chosen schemas in the export.
neowiki-bundle-export-metadata: Heading of the fields that make an export a model bundle.
neowiki-bundle-export-version: Label of the field for the version of an exported model bundle.
neowiki-bundle-export-description: Label of the field for the description of an exported model bundle.
neowiki-bundle-export-button: Label of the button that downloads the export file.
neowiki-bundle-export-unreadable-page:
Error shown when an export cannot read something it is to hold. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title, such as "Layout:Card"
neowiki-bundle-export-unreadable-subject:
Error shown when an export cannot read the subjects of a schema. Parameters:
* $1 - the schema name
neowiki-bundle-group-this-wiki: Name of the group on [[Special:DataModel]] that lists the schemas, layouts and mappings no installed model bundle has.
neowiki-bundle-group-expand:
Label of the button that unfolds a group on [[Special:DataModel]]. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the model bundle, or {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-group-this-wiki}}
neowiki-bundle-group-collapse:
Label of the button that folds a group on [[Special:DataModel]]. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the model bundle, or {{msg-mw|neowiki-bundle-group-this-wiki}}
neowiki-bundle-group-empty: Shown in an unfolded group on [[Special:DataModel]] that lists nothing.
neowiki-bundle-source-from-url:
Where an installed model bundle was read from. Parameters:
* $1 - the URL, as a link
neowiki-bundle-source-from-file: Where an installed model bundle was read from: a file chosen on a computer.
neowiki-bundle-record-link: Link, beside an installed model bundle on [[Special:DataModel]], to its install record page. Deleting that page detaches the bundle from its items.
neowiki-bundle-changed-count:
Shown beside an installed model bundle: how many of its schemas, layouts, mappings and subjects this wiki changed or deleted since. Parameters:
* $1 - how many
neowiki-bundle-version-available:
Shown beside an installed model bundle whose source URL holds another version. Parameters:
* $1 - that version
neowiki-bundle-update-from-source: Label of the button that updates an installed model bundle from the URL it was installed from.
neowiki-bundle-update-from-file: Label of the button that updates an installed model bundle from a file chosen on the computer.
